critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' array of primitives by replacing the uniform distribution with a variable-spacing logic. Specifically, define three distinct zones: (1) Cockpit/Nose area with 20% wider gaps, (2) Main Cabin area with standard spacing but 50% larger gaps centered on door locations, and (3) Tail section with 10% tighter spacing. Adjust the 'x' position parameter of each window primitive to reflect these variable intervals rather than a constant increment.
